findings.mechanism: Unbounded asyncio.Queue allows unlimited growth, providing no back‑pressure. The runtime does not enforce a size limit, so concurrent producers can keep adding events, leading to unbounded memory usage and potential OOM. Cites 04-races-and-atomicity.
findings.remediation: Replace the unbounded asyncio.Queue with a bounded queue (e.g., asyncio.Queue(maxsize=1000)) and handle QueueFull to apply back‑pressure.
findings.arithmetic: In the experiment 'queue_depth' we offer 5000 events without any consumer. An unbounded queue will have qsize=5000. With a bounded queue of maxsize=1000 the put would block/raise, preventing growth beyond 1000. Thus the threshold is 5000 items pending.
